security_cases: oversized input is rejected before expensive work
user text is rendered via textContent or escaped before any HTML preview
NaN, Infinity, invalid dates and numeric overflow paths produce explicit errors
download names are fixed or strictly sanitized; user content cannot choose a filesystem path
CSV/parser inputs stay within documented byte, row and column bounds where applicable
responsive_accessibility_cases: 320px viewport: controls collapse to one column without horizontal page scrolling
keyboard-only: every actionable control is reachable and has visible focus
screen reader: result region uses role=status and aria-live=polite
labels remain programmatically associated with inputs
reduced-motion mode does not remove information
performance_cases: worst supported row/item count remains bounded
normal calculation requires no server request
lazy dependencies are loaded only for the opened route where applicable
tool_specific: This is a deterministic scenario, not a forecast distribution. Financing timing, working-capital timing, taxes and unexpected costs can change actual runway.
